title: Kernel Methods for Learning Operators with Multiple Inputs and Outputs
abstract: arXiv:2608.11831v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Learning mappings between infinite-dimensional objects is a central challenge in scientific machine learning. We introduce a general kernel-based encoder-decoder framework for operator learning that separates observation, representation, learning, and reconstruction. We develop this framework for multi-input, multi-output operator learning, where operators map between products of potentially distinct function spaces. Our approximation theory shows that, although the number of inputs and outputs can increase, the convergence rate is governed by the most challenging constituent approximation problem rather than the overall problem dimension. The framework leads to practical kernel methods with closed-form training and inference, combining mathematical tractability with computational efficiency. translated_title: 核方法用于多输入多输出算子学习
translated_abstract: 学习无限维对象之间的映射是科学机器学习中的一个核心挑战。我们引入了一个通用的基于核的编码器-解码器框架用于算子学习，该框架将观测、表示、学习和重建分离。我们针对多输入、多输出算子学习开发了这一框架，其中算子映射在可能不同的函数空间乘积之间。我们的逼近理论表明，尽管输入和输出的数量可能增加，收敛速率由最具挑战性的组成逼近问题决定，而不是整体问题维度。该框架导致了具有闭式训练和推理的实用核方法，结合了数学可处理性和计算效率。我们进一步将方法专门化为多算子学习，通过引入KernelMO，一组具有互补算子变体的核方法族。
tldr: 本文提出了一种通用的核方法框架，用于多输入多输出算子学习，并证明其收敛速率由最难的子问题决定，同时提供了闭式训练和推理的实用算法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a general kernel-based framework for multi-input multi-output operator learning, showing convergence rates governed by the hardest subproblem and offering practical closed-form training and inference.
